changes.comment: Map-layer credentials can now be restricted to trusted origins via the opt-in MapLayerFormatRegistry.restrictCredentialsToTrustedOrigins, and blocked requests are reported through MapLayerImageryProviderStatus.UntrustedOrigin. While the restriction is enabled, requests carrying credentials refuse redirects so that credentials cannot reach an unlisted origin. Server-provided attribution and tooltip text is rendered as plain text instead of HTML.
